answer: In agent economies, Sybil resistance works via a multi-stage vault deposit system gated by a crystal reputation ridge. Each agent locks proportional stake into a communal vault; crossing the ridge requires a unique sequence of costly, non-transferable interactions that accumulate only for distinct behavioral histories. Fake identities cannot cheaply amass the required ridge height without spending real resources per clone, making mass sybil attacks economically prohibitive as the vault enforces one-to-one stake-to-identity mapping.
